message.ringbearer_harness.none: Lead a harnessed animal here to hitch it
ringbearer_harness.configuration.title: Harness
message.ringbearer_harness.needs_harness: Put a harness on it first (use a harness on the animal)
message.ringbearer_harness.cannot_wear: Only a tamed, grown animal that can pull wears a harness
message.ringbearer_harness.reins_taken: You take up the reins: W to go (sprint to canter), S to stop and back, A/D to turn
message.ringbearer_harness.reins_dropped: You let go of the reins
message.ringbearer_harness.reins_nothing: Nothing is hitched here to drive
